claim_text: The variance inflation is below one at every lag.
source_of_truth: var/insider_dispersion.db centered series, dispersion.py:104-120
reason: The only interval-shaped estimator actually computed. It reproduces at every registered bandwidth.
estimator: Newey-West Bartlett variance inflation, 1 + 2*sum_k (1 - k/(L+1)) * rho_k
data_structure: daily time series, n=2581, overlapping 126-session holds
notes: Direction matters: VIF < 1 at every lag RAISES N_eff above the raw session count and therefore LOWERS the MDE, so the serial-correlation treatment moves the verdict toward GO, not toward BLOCKED. notes: CONVENTION NOTE, recorded not raised: the quantity is t_crit*SE, i.e. the smallest alpha that would be called significant if observed exactly (50 percent power), not the conventional 80-percent-power MDE (z_a/2 + z_b)*SE = 2.80*SE. At the 80 percent convention the primary MDE would be 69.1 bp/month. The convention is written into REGISTRATION.md:82-88 before measurement and applied consistently to every series and every bar in Section 0.4, so it is not a post-hoc choice, and it cannot flatter the BLOCKED verdict because the conventional figure is larger.
